sets.title: Себя in All Cases
sets.description: Choose the correct form of себя for each context

items.prompt: Он видит _____ в зеркале. (He sees himself in the mirror.)
items.promptEnglish: He sees himself in the mirror.
items.explanation: Accusative reflexive: себя. Видеть себя = see oneself.

items.prompt: Я купила _____ новые туфли. (I bought myself new shoes.)
items.explanation: Dative reflexive: себе. Купить себе = buy for oneself.

items.prompt: Она довольна _____. (She is pleased with herself.)
items.hint: Доволен кем? Instrumental. With oneself = собой.
items.explanation: Instrumental reflexive: собой. Доволен собой = pleased with oneself.

items.prompt: Он думает только о _____. (He only thinks about himself.)
items.hint: Думать о ком? Prepositional. О себе.
items.explanation: Prepositional reflexive: себе. О себе = about oneself.

items.prompt: Возьмите это с _____. (Take this with you. - with oneself)
items.explanation: С собой = with oneself (take along). Instrumental after с.

items.prompt: Он поставил перед _____ трудную задачу. (He set a difficult task before himself.)
items.promptEnglish: He set himself a difficult task.

items.prompt: Дети остались у _____ в комнате. (The children stayed by themselves in the room.)
items.promptEnglish: The children stayed in their room by themselves.
items.explanation: У себя = at one's own place / by oneself. Genitive reflexive.

minimalPairs.explanation: Свою = his own (refers back to subject). Его = someone else's.
Его = another person's. Not the subject's own.
Своего = her own (reflexive possessive, refers to subject Маша).
Её = another person's. The cat belongs to someone else, not Masha.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: Does the possessive refer to the SUBJECT (свой) or SOMEONE ELSE (его/её/их)?

items.word: Дети играют в СВОЕЙ комнате. (their own)
Мы видели ИХ дом. (their house, not ours)
Он читает ЕЁ дневник. (her diary, not his)

sets.title: Fix and Build
sets.description: Fix свой/его confusion and build reflexive sentences
sets.descriptionRussian: Исправьте ошибки свой/его и постройте предложения

errorCorrection.sentence: Она любит её работу. (intended: her own work)
errorCorrection.hint: Her OWN work (subject's own) = свою, not её.
errorCorrection.explanation: Subject's own: свою работу. Её = another woman's work.

errorCorrection.hint: Доволен кем? Instrumental. Себя is accusative/genitive.

errorCorrection.sentence: Мы пригласили друзей в наш дом.
errorCorrection.hint: When the subject is мы and the possessive refers to мы, use свой.
errorCorrection.explanation: Subject's own: в свой дом. Наш is not wrong here, but свой is the standard reflexive.

errorCorrection.hint: Took with him = с собой (took along). Себя alone doesn't mean 'with.'
errorCorrection.explanation: С собой = with oneself (took along). Себя without с doesn't work here.

translation.english: She bought herself a new dress.
He is not satisfied with himself.
They love their own children very much.
translation.hint: Their own = своих (genitive/accusative plural, animate). Children = детей.

items.prompt: Чувствуйте _____ как дома! (Make yourself at home!)
items.promptEnglish: Make yourself at home! (Feel yourself as at home.)
items.explanation: Чувствовать себя = feel oneself. Accusative: себя.

items.prompt: Я взяла с _____ книгу. (I took a book with me.)
items.promptEnglish: I took a book with me (brought along).
items.explanation: С собой = with oneself (took along). Instrumental after с.

items.prompt: Маша попросила Аню дать ей _____ тетрадь. (Masha asked Anya to give her Anya's notebook.)
items.promptEnglish: Masha asked Anya to give her Anya's own notebook.
items.hint: Свою refers to the subject of the infinitive clause (Аня gives HER OWN).
items.explanation: Свою refers to Anya (the logical subject of 'дать'): Anya's own notebook.

items.prompt: Себя can never be used as the _____.
items.hint: Себя has no nominative form. It can't be the subject.
items.explanation: Себя has no nominative: it can only be an object (accusative, genitive, dative, instrumental, prepositional).

items.prompt: Дети играли у _____ в комнате. (The children played in their own room.)
items.promptEnglish: The children played in their own room.
items.hint: У себя = at one's own place. Genitive of себя.
items.explanation: У себя = at one's own place/room. Fixed expression with genitive.

items.prompt: Каждый должен решать _____ проблемы сам. (Everyone must solve their own problems themselves.)
items.promptEnglish: Everyone must solve their own problems themselves.
items.hint: Their OWN = свои (refers back to subject каждый).
items.explanation: Свои = one's own (plural accusative). Refers back to каждый.

patternRecognition.question: What is notable about the declension of себя?
patternRecognition.explanation: Себя has no nominative because it can never be the subject. It starts at accusative/genitive.

patternRecognition.sentence: Он любит свою жену. / Она любит своего мужа. / Они любят своих детей.
patternRecognition.question: What determines the form of свой here?
options: The gender/number/case of the possessed noun
patternRecognition.answer: The gender/number/case of the possessed noun
patternRecognition.explanation: Свой agrees with the OWNED thing, not the owner: свою жену (fem acc), своего мужа (masc anim acc), своих детей (pl anim acc).

blanks: Не забудь взять с _____ паспорт! (Don't forget to take your passport with you!)
Каждый знает _____ недостатки. (Everyone knows their own flaws.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: с собой for 'take along,' свои for subject's own
hints: Their own flaws (refers to каждый) = свои.
explanations: Свои = one's own (plural, refers to subject каждый).
